title: PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
body: Principal ML Scientist and Researcher with 8+ years of expertise in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and large-scale production-grade Machine Learning systems. Proven track record of delivering high-impact business outcomes ($300M+ revenue growth at Nike) and leading cutting-edge initiatives in generative 3D modeling, vector search, multi-agent systems, and federated learning. Author of 15+ peer-reviewed papers in top-tier AI/ML venues (NeurIPS, ICLR, COLT, UAI, KDD) and primary developer of high-performance open-source software (Saemix, 18K+ downloads/yr). Excellent technical leader with a history of advising successful startups from inception to acquisition.
